acceptance_predicates.description: Users can add, edit, refresh, and cancel a provider profile without losing the last valid configuration.
A connected provider exposes only its supported model choices and records typed unavailable reasons when refresh fails.
Absent credentials, signatures, or key management produce visible development-only warnings and never block setup or offline execution.
Provider references and diagnostics are redacted and never contain API keys or raw responses.

definition_of_done: Focused provider lifecycle and model filtering tests pass.
Independent exact-head review and hosted checks pass.
